name: Goshujin-sama e
source:
Main character finally gathers courage to confess to a girl, and - surprisingly - answer is positive. They start dating and get first sex experience. But girl's desire gradually grows and she shows signs of it, but these signs are only noticed when protagonist picks up a SM book she read while falling asleep. Boy starts to study the issue and cultivate appreciation of S in him...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角終於鼓起勇氣向女孩告白，意外得到了肯定答覆。兩人開始交往，也迎來第一次性經驗。但女孩的慾望逐漸增長，開始顯露徵兆；直到主角拿起她睡著前讀的那本SM書，才注意到這些跡象。男孩開始研究這個問題，也漸漸體會到當S的樂趣……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
